newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Byblos Bank plans $300 mln in EuroCDs.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Byblos Bank plans $300 mln in EuroCDs.

text.p: Lebanon's Byblos Bank announced on Thursday the launch of a $300-million EuroCD programme.
Chairman Francois Bassil said the first $100 million tranche would be issued in the second quarter of this year.
The programme would be managed by Merrill Lynch in association with the Dutch bank ABN AMRO, Bassil said.

Byblos issued a $50 million Eurobond in September 1996 which was heavily oversubscribed. It is one of the most dynamic among Lebanon's 82 commercial banks and ranked seventh in 1995 in customer deposits.
